251:   private void doQueryFirstScoring(Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost[] dims)
252:       throws IOException {
253:     setScorer(collector, ScoreCachingWrappingScorer.wrap(baseScorer));
254: 
255:     // Specialize the single-dim use-case as we have a more efficient implementation for that:
256:     if (dims.length == 1) {
257:       doQueryFirstScoringSingleDim(acceptDocs, collector, dims[0]);
258:       return;
259:     }
260: 
261:     // Sort our sideways dims by approximation cost so we can advance the lower cost ones first:
262:     List<DocsAndCost> sidewaysDims = new ArrayList<>(dims.length);
263:     sidewaysDims.addAll(List.of(dims));
264:     CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysDims, APPROXIMATION_COMPARATOR);
265: 
266:     // Maintain (optional) subset of sideways dims that support two-phase iteration, sorted by
267:     // matchCost:
268:     List<DocsAndCost> sidewaysTwoPhaseDims = null;
269:     for (DocsAndCost dim : dims) {
270:       if (dim.twoPhase != null) {
271:         if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims == null) {
272:           sidewaysTwoPhaseDims = new ArrayList<>();
273:         }
274:         sidewaysTwoPhaseDims.add(dim);
275:       }
276:     }
277:     if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
278:       CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysTwoPhaseDims, TWO_PHASE_COMPARATOR);
279:     }

281:     // We keep track of a "runaway" dimension, which is a previously "near missed" dimension that
282:     // has advanced beyond the docID the rest of the dimensions are positioned on. This functions
283:     // a bit like the "head" queue in WANDScorer's "min should match" implementation. We use a
284:     // single-valued PQ ordered by docID to easily determine the "closest" runaway dim we'll use
285:     // for advancing in the case that multiple dim approximations miss.
286:     PriorityQueue<DocsAndCost> runawayDim =
287:         new PriorityQueue<>(1) {
288:           @Override
289:           protected boolean lessThan(DocsAndCost a, DocsAndCost b) {
290:             return a.approximation.docID() < b.approximation.docID();
291:           }
292:         };
293: 
294:     int docID = baseApproximation.docID();
295: 
296:     nextDoc:
297:     while (docID != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
298:       assert docID == baseApproximation.docID();
299: 
300:       if (acceptDocs != null && acceptDocs.get(docID) == false) {
301:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
302:         continue;
303:       }
304: 
305:       // If we carried a "runaway" over from the last iteration, see if we've "caught up" yet:
306:       DocsAndCost runaway = runawayDim.top();
307:       if (runaway != null && runaway.approximation.docID() <= docID) {
308:         runawayDim.clear();
309:         runaway = null;
310:       }
311: 
312:       // Check the sideways dim approximations. At most, one dim is allowed to miss for the doc
313:       // to be a near-miss or full match. If multiple sideways dims miss, we move on:
314:       for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysDims) {
315:         int dimDocID = advanceIfBehind(docID, dim.approximation);
316:         if (dimDocID != docID && dim != runaway) {
317:           DocsAndCost evicted = runawayDim.insertWithOverflow(dim);
318:           if (evicted != null) {
319:             // More than one dim has advanced beyond docID, so we jump ahead to the "closer" of
320:             // the two:
321:             int next = evicted.approximation.docID();
322:             docID = baseApproximation.advance(next);
323:             continue nextDoc;
324:           }
325:         }
326:       }
327: 
328:       // At this point, we have an "approximate" near-miss or full match, but we still need
329:       // to confirm two-phase iterators. First, check the base two-phase (it's always required):
330:       if (baseTwoPhase != null && baseTwoPhase.matches() == false) {
331:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
332:         continue;
333:       }
334: 
335:       // If we have two-phase iterators for our sideways dims, check them now. At most, one
336:       // sideways dim can miss for the doc to be a near-miss or full match. If more than one misses
337:       // we move on:
338:       DocsAndCost failedDim = runawayDim.top();
339:       if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
340:         if (failedDim == null) {
341:           // If all sideways dims matched in their approximation phase, then we can allow one
342:           // second-phase check to fail:
343:           for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
344:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
345:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
346:               if (failedDim != null) {
347:                 // Two second-phase checks have failed, so we move on:
348:                 docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
349:                 continue nextDoc;
350:               } else {
351:                 failedDim = dim;
352:               }
353:             }
354:           }
355:         } else {
356:           // If a sideways dim failed the approximate check, then no second-phase checks can fail:
357:           for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
358:             if (failedDim == dim) {
359:               continue;
360:             }
361:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
362:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
363:               docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
364:               continue nextDoc;
365:             }
366:           }
367:         }
368:       }
369: 
370:       collectDocID = docID;
371:       if (failedDim == null) {
372:         // Hit passed all filters, so it's "real":
373:         collectHit(collector, sidewaysDims);
374:       } else {
375:         // Hit missed exactly one dim:
376:         collectNearMiss(failedDim.sidewaysLeafCollector);
377:       }
378: 
379:       docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
380:     }
381:   }

601:   private void doUnionScoring(Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost[] dims)
602:       throws IOException {
603:     // if (DEBUG) {
604:     //  System.out.println("  doUnionScoring");
605:     // }
606:     setScorer(collector, new ScoreAndDoc());
607: 
608:     final int maxDoc = context.reader().maxDoc();
609:     final int numDims = dims.length;
610: 
611:     // TODO: maybe a class like BS, instead of parallel arrays
612:     int[] filledSlots = new int[CHUNK];
613:     int[] docIDs = new int[CHUNK];
614:     float[] scores = new float[CHUNK];
615:     int[] missingDims = new int[CHUNK];
616:     int[] counts = new int[CHUNK];
617: 
618:     docIDs[0] = -1;
619: 
620:     // NOTE: this is basically a specialized version of
621:     // BooleanScorer, to the minShouldMatch=N-1 case, but
622:     // carefully tracking which dimension failed to match
623: 
624:     int nextChunkStart = CHUNK;
625: 
626:     while (true) {
627:       // if (DEBUG) {
628:       //  System.out.println("\ncycle nextChunkStart=" + nextChunkStart + " docIds[0]=" +
629:       // docIDs[0]);
630:       // }
631:       int filledCount = 0;
632:       int docID = baseIterator.docID();
633:       // if (DEBUG) {
634:       //  System.out.println("  base docID=" + docID);
635:       // }
636:       while (docID < nextChunkStart) {
637:         if (acceptDocs == null || acceptDocs.get(docID)) {
638:           int slot = docID & MASK;
639:           // if (DEBUG) {
640:           //  System.out.println("    docIDs[slot=" + slot + "]=" + docID + " id=" +
641:           // context.reader().document(docID).get("id"));
642:           // }
643: 
644:           // Mark slot as valid:
645:           assert docIDs[slot] != docID : "slot=" + slot + " docID=" + docID;
646:           docIDs[slot] = docID;
647:           scores[slot] = baseScorer.score();
648:           filledSlots[filledCount++] = slot;
649:           missingDims[slot] = 0;
650:           counts[slot] = 1;
651:         }
652:         docID = baseIterator.nextDoc();
653:       }
654: 
655:       if (filledCount == 0) {
656:         if (nextChunkStart >= maxDoc) {
657:           break;
658:         }
659:         nextChunkStart += CHUNK;
660:         continue;
661:       }
662: 
663:       // First drill-down dim, basically adds SHOULD onto
664:       // the baseQuery:
665:       // if (DEBUG) {
666:       //  System.out.println("  dim=0 [" + dims[0].dim + "]");
667:       // }
668:       {
669:         DocsAndCost dc = dims[0];
670:         docID = dc.approximation.docID();
671:         // if (DEBUG) {
672:         //  System.out.println("    start docID=" + docID);
673:         // }
674:         while (docID < nextChunkStart) {
675:           int slot = docID & MASK;
676:           if (docIDs[slot] == docID // this also checks that the doc is not deleted
677:               && (dc.twoPhase == null || dc.twoPhase.matches())) {
678:             // if (DEBUG) {
679:             //  System.out.println("      set docID=" + docID + " count=2");
680:             // }
681:             missingDims[slot] = 1;
682:             counts[slot] = 2;
683:           }
684:           docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();
685:         }
686:       }
687: 
688:       for (int dim = 1; dim < numDims; dim++) {
689:         // if (DEBUG) {
690:         //  System.out.println("  dim=" + dim + " [" + dims[dim].dim + "]");
691:         // }
692: 
693:         DocsAndCost dc = dims[dim];
694:         docID = dc.approximation.docID();
695:         // if (DEBUG) {
696:         //  System.out.println("    start docID=" + docID);
697:         // }
698:         while (docID < nextChunkStart) {
699:           int slot = docID & MASK;
700:           if (docIDs[slot] == docID // also means that the doc is not deleted
701:               && counts[slot] >= dim
702:               && (dc.twoPhase == null || dc.twoPhase.matches())) {
703:             // This doc is still in the running...
704:             // TODO: single-valued dims will always be true
705:             // below; we could somehow specialize
706:             if (missingDims[slot] >= dim) {
707:               // if (DEBUG) {
708:               //  System.out.println("      set docID=" + docID + " count=" + (dim+2));
709:               // }
710:               missingDims[slot] = dim + 1;
711:               counts[slot] = dim + 2;
712:             } else {
713:               // if (DEBUG) {
714:               //  System.out.println("      set docID=" + docID + " missing count=" + (dim+1));
715:               // }
716:               counts[slot] = dim + 1;
717:             }
718:           }
719:           docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();
720:         }
721:       }
722: 
723:       // Collect:
724:       // System.out.println("  now collect: " + filledCount + " hits");
725:       for (int i = 0; i < filledCount; i++) {
726:         // NOTE: This is actually in-order collection,
727:         // because we only accept docs originally returned by
728:         // the baseScorer (ie that Scorer is AND'd)
729:         int slot = filledSlots[i];
730:         collectDocID = docIDs[slot];
731:         collectScore = scores[slot];
732:         // if (DEBUG) {
733:         //  System.out.println("    docID=" + docIDs[slot] + " count=" + counts[slot]);
734:         // }
735:         // System.out.println("  collect doc=" + collectDocID + " main.freq=" + (counts[slot]-1) + "
736:         // main.doc=" + collectDocID + " exactCount=" + numDims);
737:         if (counts[slot] == 1 + numDims) {
738:           // System.out.println("    hit");
739:           collectHit(collector, dims);
740:         } else if (counts[slot] == numDims) {
741:           // System.out.println("    sw");
742:           collectNearMiss(dims[missingDims[slot]].sidewaysLeafCollector);
743:         }
744:       }
745: 
746:       if (nextChunkStart >= maxDoc) {
747:         break;
748:       }
749: 
750:       nextChunkStart += CHUNK;
751:     }
752:   }

1000:   String[] decodePath(String s) {
1001:     this.pathDecoderParts.clear();
1002:     this.pathEscapePending = false;
1003:     int length = s.length();
1004:     if (length == 0) {
1005:       this.lastEncodedPath = "";
1006:       this.lastEncodedLength = 0;
1007:       return new String[0];
1008:     }
1009:     ensureDecoderCapacity(length);
1010:     int upto = 0;
1011:     for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
1012:       char ch = s.charAt(i);
1013:       if (this.pathEscapePending) {
1014:         this.pathDecoderChars[upto++] = ch;
1015:         this.pathEscapePending = false;
1016:       } else if (ch == FacetsConfig.ESCAPE_CHAR) {
1017:         this.pathEscapePending = true;
1018:       } else if (ch == FacetsConfig.DELIM_CHAR) {
1019:         this.pathDecoderParts.add(new String(this.pathDecoderChars, 0, upto));
1020:         upto = 0;
1021:       } else {
1022:         this.pathDecoderChars[upto++] = ch;
1023:       }
1024:     }
1025:     this.pathDecoderParts.add(new String(this.pathDecoderChars, 0, upto));
1026:     assert !this.pathEscapePending;
1027:     return copyDecodedParts();
